#{A precision Guided Local Search penalty mechanism that adaptively scales penalties based on tour edge length dispersion and relative percentile rank to penalize detrimental outlier edges more aggressively.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_lengths = tour_lengths[selected_mask]
    
    n_edges = len(tour_lengths)
    if n_edges > 1:
        ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(tour_lengths)) / (n_edges - 1.0)
    else:
        ranks = np.zeros_like(tour_lengths)
    sel_ranks = ranks[selected_mask]
    
    mean_len = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    std_len = np.std(tour_lengths)
    dispersion_factor = 1.0 + (std_len / (mean_len + 1e-12))
    
    base_penalties = 0.3 * (0.5 * mean_len + 0.5 * sel_lengths)
    adaptive_penalties = base_penalties * dispersion_factor * (1.0 + sel_ranks)
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += adaptive_penalties
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += adaptive_penalties
    
    return updated_edge_distance
